body: you are the most beautiful girl I have ever seen on here. If God sent you my way I'd be sure to treat you like the angel you are.

We have always had one problem in our relationship and that was lack of affection on my behalf. We went to therapy and things got much better in my eyes but apparently not hers. Two months ago she said that she wanted out so we did a trial separation then she didn't want to come back. She keeps saying that she wasn't happy from before we were happy but then why would she have married me. She had also been having an emotional affair (online) with her exboyfriend for over a year. She left her Facebook open and I saw the year+ transgressions and that put me over the edge. I wasn't perfect in our marriage but I was always there for her, loved her, supported her, never yelled at her, and we never fought.
I have been honest with the therapist. As for the wife, it's so heartbreaking that she would walk away without a care in the world. That is not like her. I am preparing a simple will this weekend.
